fusions.name: Final Draft
fusions.desc: Throws a pressed sheet that deals 30 damage as a guaranteed critical hit.

fusions.name: Page Flurry
fusions.desc: Looses a cone of loose pages that deals 3 damage to everything in it. Each hit has a 25% chance to leave the target [Blunted] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Binding Clause
fusions.desc: For 4 seconds, blows that reach you deal no damage and no condition can take hold of you.

fusions.name: Fibre Memory
fusions.desc: Every ability you have comes round 8% sooner. Your armour is 8% higher.
